messages:
tara: FYI: v2 SDK will rename parameter `response_format` -> `output_format` in the generation calls. this landed in runtime yesterday and will be part of next-week release. starting a quick docs + snippets thread.
miguel: are we changing the API surface or just SDK param names?
tara: runtime accepts both for now, but SDK surfaces changed to encourage the new name. we need a migration note, a short compatibility shim example, and redirects for docs that reference the old arg.
priya: can we add a tiny compat shim in the TS/py SDKs that maps legacy param to new one and emits a deprecation warning? that avoids immediate breakage and gives users time.
ollie: agree. also add a short section in the migration guide showing old->new mapping table and example callsites to update. keep it visible.
amanda: i'll draft the deprecation banner and a one-liner at top of the generation guide.
priya: shim example (TS) i propose for docs: 
```ts
// shim: map legacy `response_format` to new `output_format` and warn once
function normalizeOpts(opts) {
  if (opts.response_format && !opts.output_format) {
    console.warn('DEPRECATION: `response_format` will be removed. use `output_format`.');
    opts.output_format = opts.response_format;
  }
  return opts;
}
```
miguel: add a runtime header example so servers can surface a structured deprecation notice to clients: 
```
Deprecation-Warning: response_format deprecated; use output_format; removal-date=2026-06-01
```
tara: good. for Python snippet: 
```py
# simple shim for python SDK
def _normalize(opts):
    if 'response_format' in opts and 'output_format' not in opts:
        import warnings
        warnings.warn('`response_format` deprecated; use `output_format`', DeprecationWarning)
        opts['output_format'] = opts.pop('response_format')
    return opts
```
ollie: add a short test to docs PR that asserts warning is logged when old arg used and that both codepaths produce same outputs. test should be unit-level.
priya: opened PR draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127 (includes mapping table, shim snippets, deprecation banner draft). tagging @dev-experince @eng-runtime for review.
amanda: i'll add redirects for old doc URLs and a note in the changelog. also update examples in the quickstart repo.
miguel: one more: include a tiny checklist in the migration guide for customers: 1) search codebase for `response_format`; 2) migrate to `output_format`; 3) run tests and watch for Deprecation-Warning header.
priya: lint & example nit: update code examples in the JS quickstart and the cURL examples too. include both forms in the migration docs for 2 weeks.
ollie: add a short paragraph in the SDK release notes explaining semantic change if any (none), and clarifying removal timeline.
dev-bot: auto-test: docs PR 4127 has failing linter on examples.md line 42.
priya: fixing now. small formatting thing.
amanda: once merged, i'll trigger snippets backfill across the snippets repo and create a follow-up PR for quickstart.
docs-bot: PR 4127 merged into main by priya  thanks everyone!
miguel: great. follow-up tasks: amanda to push the redirects, ollie to add unit test, tara to notify support templates. tagging in PR description for watchers.
tara: will send a short customer comms note calling out SDK param rename, compatibility shim, and removal date. keep it factual and include migration steps.
priya: thanks all. will create a tiny FAQ entry: "Why does my SDK warn about response_format?" with link to mapping table.
amanda: scheduling a docs deploy for tomorrow morning after QA.
